visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white off-the-shoulder ruffled top and a short denim skirt, dancing energetically. She is standing in a modern parking lot equipped with electric vehicle charging stations under a large canopy labeled "EVOASIS". A sleek gray Tesla Model 3 is parked and connected to a charger. The lighting is bright, natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts as the woman walks towards a large blue promotional pillar containing text. She gestures excitedly with her hands, smiling broadly at the camera. In the background, urban office buildings and other parked cars are clearly visible. The environment transitions from the immediate charging stall to a wider view of the facility's entrance area near a busy street. (3) The woman is seen sitting inside the Tesla, then walking on a city sidewalk past a 7-Eleven convenience store and a Louisa Coffee shop. She holds a red coffee cup, emphasizing the amenities near the charging station. The camera follows her in a handheld style, showing her casual and friendly demeanor against the urban backdrop. (4) Returning to the charging station, she demonstrates the charging process by touching the car's charging port and looking at the digital screen on the charger which displays battery percentages. The video concludes with a wide shot of the EVOASIS signage and the woman waving goodbye, inviting viewers to visit the site.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic pop background track featuring a driving beat and bright synthesized melodies. No vocals are present initially, establishing a rhythmic and upbeat atmosphere. Ambient urban sounds like distant traffic hum are barely audible under the clean musical mix. (2) A female voice enters with high enthusiasm and a sharp, clear pitch. Her speech rate is fast and rhythmic, perfectly synchronized with the upbeat tempo of the background music. She enunciates with a friendly and professional narrative tone, introducing the station with high emotional energy. (3) The narration continues as the speaker describes the location's convenience and nearby shops. Her voice maintains high arousal and positive valence throughout the segment. Short structural pauses occur between sentences to create a natural conversational flow, while the electronic music bed continues consistently underneath. (4) As technical details about charging speed are explained, the narrator's tone becomes more informative yet remains highly energetic. A distinct mechanical click sound is briefly audible when she interacts with the charger. The audio track concludes with an enthusiastic call to action as the music fades out.
